title: Closing thanks
summary: Hinton thanks Budd, citing Keg Johnson's wish that young people hear these stories.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Hey, Budd, I don't know how to thank you. In the words of your dear brother, Ray J Koo Johnson, which, when he finished one of his interviews with Perry Bradford, Kog said that he wished that all the world, all of the young people in the world could hear these stories and hear what the dues as you and people like you and people before us paid to get this beautiful art form to where it is, and that this is truly an American art form --
